entities.title: A JSON Schema for the utv-result/1.0 envelope
entities.summary: Results have a normative contract in RESULT-CONTRACT.md but no schema.
entities.details: The result envelope is specified in prose only, so neither a library's results nor the fixtures' expected results can be checked structurally as a whole. Resolving it additively is a minor version (1.1); renaming or removing fields is a major version; clarifying prose without changing any serialized form or result is a patch (VERSIONING.md).
acceptanceCriteria: schema/ has a schema for utv-result/1.0, and tools/validate.py checks it is valid Draft 2020-12.

entities.title: A JSON Schema for registry entries and rule manifests
entities.summary: The registry contract of spec §16 has no machine-readable form.
entities.details: Registry entries and rule manifests are described in §16 and RESULT-CONTRACT's manifest semantics only. Resolving it additively is a minor version (1.1); renaming or removing fields is a major version; clarifying prose without changing any serialized form or result is a patch (VERSIONING.md).
acceptanceCriteria: schema/ has a schema for registry entries and rule manifests.
